title: BioIVT: surgical procedure questions become a type-ahead SNOMED CT procedures lookup
description: Turns the free-text Surgical Procedure question on Oncology, Follow-up and Outcome into a type-ahead lookup over real SNOMED CT procedure codes (1,900 procedures). Detroit sites also enter specimen-collection procedures here (real data: 'Blood draw' 8,275 answers, 'CSF Collection' 5,670), so the list includes them alongside resections, biopsies and organ removals. DEMONSTRATION list: real codes, partial, not clinically reviewed; licences to be confirmed before real use.
rationale: Dan asked for the Surgical Procedure to be added. Values chosen from what Detroit sites actually enter.
source: BioIVT Option C build for the client demonstration; approved by Dan

history.note: Phase 2 build for the client demonstration.
